instructions: Run tests or programs with {"action":"run","argv":["python3","-B","-S","script.py"]}. Use argument arrays, never a shell command string. Optional cwd is workspace-relative. The host kills commands at its configured timeout (default 30 seconds; timed-out results say so in stderr) and keeps only the first 1536 bytes of each output stream, so run short, noninteractive commands that print little. A command that legitimately needs longer may set "timeout" (seconds, up to 120) on the run action. Inspect returncode and truncation metadata before reporting success.
